question: In February 2025, who won the men’s title at the 2025 Asian Snooker Championship held in Doha, Qatar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Advani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Advani**, an iconic Indian cueist, won the **Men’s Title** at the **2025 Asian Snooker Championship** held in **Doha, Qatar**.
 
• This victory further added to his illustrious career, making him one of the most decorated players in the world of snooker and billiards.
 
• Pankaj Advani has been consistently dominating the cue sports arena, having already won multiple world titles across formats like **English Billiards** and **Snooker**.
 
• The championship witnessed participation from top-notch players across Asia, but Advani’s exceptional skill and composure stood out, leading him to clinch the title.
 
• His victory highlights **India’s dominance** in cue sports and serves as an inspiration for upcoming players in the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pankaj Advani’s Career Highlights:**

 
 
• Pankaj Advani is an Indian professional cueist who has won **25 world titles** across **Snooker** and **English Billiards** as of 2025.
 
• He is the only player to achieve the **Career Grand Slam** in billiards, winning the **World, Asian, and Indian National Championship titles** in all formats.
 
• He has been conferred prestigious awards like the **Padma Bhushan** (2018), **Padma Shri** (2009), and the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** (2006).
 
 
 
• **Asian Snooker Championship:**
 
 
• It is a premier snooker tournament organized by the **Asian Confederation of Billiard Sports (ACBS)**.
 
• The championship features the best players from across Asia and is considered a stepping stone for players aiming to compete at the global level.
 
• The 2025 edition in Doha, Qatar, witnessed stiff competition, but Advani’s strategic gameplay and consistency ensured his victory.
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Players in the 2025 Edition:**
 
 
• **Amir Sarkosh:** An accomplished cueist from **Iran**, known for his aggressive style of play.
 
• **Narantuya Bayarsaikhan:** A talented player from **Mongolia**, often recognized for his precision shots.
 
• **Chang Yu Kiu:** A rising star from **Hong Kong**, showcasing significant potential in international snooker circuits.
 
 
 
• **India’s Legacy in Cue Sports:**
 
 
• India has a rich history in billiards and snooker, with players like **Geet Sethi** and **Michael Ferreira** paving the way for global recognition.
 
• Pankaj Advani has carried forward this legacy, becoming a global ambassador for Indian cue sports.
 
• His achievements have inspired many young talents in India to take up snooker and billiards professionally.
